photos.alt: A market display of apples, lemons, cherries, grapes, and corn
photos.source_identity: commons:File:DSC 9451 A colorful market display of fresh produce including apples lemons cherries grapes and ears of corn.jpg
photos.creator: PattayaPatrol
photos.description: This vibrant close-up photograph captures an abundant display of fresh produce, likely at a market in Thailand. The arrangement features a colorful variety of fruits and vegetables, with glossy red apples (one bearing a small sticker) taking center stage alongside bright yellow lemons or oranges. Dark, plump cherries and clusters of red-purple grapes add rich color contrast to the composition. In the foreground, bright yellow ears of corn and what appear to be wrapped white items (possibly bamboo shoots or similar produce) provide texture variety. The background shows a bowl of shredded cabbage or lettuce and hints of additional packaged goods, while small red tomatoes peek through on the left side. The lighting highlights the natural sheen and freshness of the produce, creating an inviting and bountiful market scene.
photos.commons_title: File:DSC 9451 A colorful market display of fresh produce including apples lemons cherries grapes and ears of corn.jpg
